nodes.description: Constant holding the number of seconds in a day (86400), used for day-based release math.
Immutable IERC20 token held and distributed by the timelock.
Immutable beneficiary address that receives released tokens.
Immutable timestamp when the linear release period starts.
End timestamp of the release period; also mutated in terminate().
Total amount of benefit allocated to the beneficiary; reduced on termination.
Running total of tokens already withdrawn by the beneficiary.
Flag indicating the contract has been terminated by the owner.
Owner address inherited from Ownable, set at construction.
SupervisedTimelock constructor: stores token, beneficiary and release schedule and validates release end time against block.timestamp.
View returning the held token address.
View returning the beneficiary address.
View returning the total benefit amount.
Computes linearly released balance from block.timestamp, release start/end times and total benefit.
Returns totalBenefit minus releasedBalance.
View returning the amount already withdrawn.
Beneficiary withdrawal: computes delta, updates withdrawal balance and transfers tokens.
Owner-only termination: truncates totalBenefit and transfers unreleased remainder to the owner.
Ownable function transferring ownership to a new address, guarded by onlyOwner.
Private helper that writes the owner state variable and emits OwnershipTransferred.
Modifier requiring owner() == _msgSender() before executing the guarded body.
Modifier requiring the contract not be terminated.
SafeERC20 wrapper performing an ERC20 transfer via a low-level external call.
Private SafeERC20 helper executing the external token call and decoding the optional boolean return.
Address library low-level call wrapper that verifies contract code and success.
msg.sender, the external caller obtained via _msgSender().
block.timestamp, miner-influenced time source driving release calculations.
External ERC20 transfer call to an arbitrary token address, executed before/around state updates (reentrancy surface).
Arithmetic on token amounts and day counts (multiplication, division, subtraction) in release/withdraw/terminate logic.
Control flow and amounts depend on block.timestamp, which is miner-manipulable (timestamp dependency).
Constructor parameter: the IERC20 token held by the timelock.
Constructor parameter: beneficiary address.
Constructor parameter: requested release start timestamp (truncated to a day boundary).
Constructor parameter: number of days of the timelock period.
Constructor parameter: total benefit amount allocated.
Parameter of transferOwnership: the new owner address.
Local in withdraw(): releasedBalance() - _withdrawedBalance, amount to transfer.
Local in terminate(): contract token balance minus remaining unreleased benefit.
Local in releasedBalance(): days elapsed since release start.
Local in releasedBalance(): total days of the release period.
Local in _setOwner(): previous owner address used for the event.

edges.reason: Constructor consumes the token_ parameter to initialize the held token.
token_ is assigned to the _token state variable.
Constructor consumes the beneficiary_ parameter.
beneficiary_ is assigned to the _beneficiary state variable.
Constructor consumes and truncates releaseStartTime_.
releaseStartTime_ is assigned to _releaseStartTime.
Constructor consumes daysOfTimelock_ to compute the release end time.
Constructor consumes totalBenefit_.
totalBenefit_ is assigned to _totalBenefit.
transferOwnership consumes the newOwner parameter.
newOwner is forwarded to _setOwner which writes it to storage.
Constructor uses SECONDS_OF_A_DAY to normalize the start time.
Constructor writes _releaseEndTime from daysOfTimelock_ and SECONDS_OF_A_DAY.
Constructor initializes _totalBenefit.
Constructor initializes _withdrawedBalance to zero.
Constructor initializes _isTerminated to false.
Constructor calls _setOwner(_msgSender()) to set the initial owner.
Constructor requires _releaseEndTime > block.timestamp, a timestamp dependency.
token() reads _token.
beneficiary() reads _beneficiary.
totalBenefit() reads _totalBenefit.
releasedBalance() compares against _releaseStartTime.
releasedBalance() compares against _releaseEndTime.
releasedBalance() scales _totalBenefit by elapsed days.
releasedBalance() divides elapsed seconds by SECONDS_OF_A_DAY.
unreleasedBalance() subtracts releasedBalance() from _totalBenefit.
unreleasedBalance() calls releasedBalance().
withdrawedBalance() reads _withdrawedBalance.
withdraw() reads releasedBalance() twice for the check and the amount.
withdraw() compares and increments _withdrawedBalance.
withdraw() transfers the amount to the beneficiary address.
withdraw() calls SafeERC20.safeTransfer on the token.
terminate() resets _totalBenefit to releasedBalance().
terminate() overwrites _releaseEndTime with the current day boundary.
terminate() sets _isTerminated to true.
terminate() writes the truncated _totalBenefit.
terminate() reads _withdrawedBalance to compute the remaining amount.
terminate() sends the remaining tokens to owner().
terminate() calls SafeERC20.safeTransfer to move the unreleased balance.
_setOwner writes the _owner state variable.
onlyOwner reads owner() (i.e. _owner) for the access check.
onlyOwner compares owner() with _msgSender(), so msg.sender gates privileged functions.
isNotTerminated reads _isTerminated to gate execution.
safeTransfer forwards encoded call data to _callOptionalReturn.
_callOptionalReturn invokes Address.functionCall for the low-level external call.
Address.functionCall performs the actual external call to the target token contract.
releasedBalance() derives results from block.timestamp, a timestamp dependency.
terminate() uses block.timestamp to truncate the release end time.
block.timestamp flows into the timestamp-dependent release logic node.
withdraw() triggers an external token transfer that can re-enter before completion.
terminate() triggers an external token transfer to the owner, a reentrancy surface.
_callOptionalReturn drives the low-level external call to the token.
safeTransfer leads to the external ERC20 call.
withdraw() computes releasedBalance() - _withdrawedBalance and increments the balance.
releasedBalance() multiplies and divides token amounts by day counts.
terminate() performs subtractions on balances to compute the owner payout.
releasedBalance() branches on block.timestamp, a miner-manipulable value.
terminate() relies on block.timestamp for the new release end time.
withdraw() local amount holds the computed payout used by safeTransfer.
terminate() local amountToWithdraw is the value transferred to the owner.
releasedBalance() local passedDays participates in the pro-rata computation.
releasedBalance() local totalDays is the denominator of the pro-rata ratio.
_setOwner() local oldOwner holds the previous owner for the ownership event.
terminate() is gated by the isNotTerminated modifier.
terminate() is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
transferOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
